actions: Launched a new campaign for the Nov 17 hormones and wellness event on Oct 30, with four ads testing different openings, set to run through Nov 16.
Raised the wellness event campaign budget from $20 to $26.60 a day on Nov 2.
Switched off the tox $9.50 per unit campaign on Nov 2.
Removed one wellness event ad and its ad set, and switched off a second event ad set, on Nov 2.
Put a new image on the wellness event ads and re-saved two tox image ads on Nov 2.
Added Instagram Explore and Instagram Search to the tox ad set placements on Oct 29.

campaigns.campaign_name: KS/MM- DCT- LEAD-La Bella Sea Girt-$.9.50 + Free Consultation/ Facial Analysis- CBO
KS/MM- DCT- Wellness Event- La Bella Sea Girt- Lead- CBO

insights.creative: The event ad that opens 'Your wellness questions deserve real answers' brought 7 of the 11 Meta leads on $63.82. It invites people to the Nov 17 hormones and wellness event with a free consult, same-day blood work and a gift card giveaway. The returning-visitor tox ad brought 3 on $57.49 with tox at $9.50 per unit and a free consultation. Worth testing a second event ad that also opens on getting real answers, since that opening brought the most leads at the lowest cost.
insights.doing: 9 leads reached the CRM this week at $18.61 each, up from 2 at $67.36 the week before, on $167.46 of spend. Meta counted 11. Most of the CRM leads came from the new wellness event campaign.
insights.look_into: Meta counted 11 leads but 9 reached the CRM, so worth checking whether the other 2 came through. The tox offer campaign was switched off on Nov 2 and still spent $94.56 this week, likely before the switch.
insights.next: We recommend keeping the wellness event campaign running up to the Nov 17 event and checking how many of its leads book a time slot, since booked visits matter more than form fills here.
